name: SKILL_WIDE_REALITY_DISPATCH_SCOPE_ENFORCEMENT
page_name: 整体闭环极限时间引擎 5.2版
purpose: 把完整 Reality Dispatch 合同从“核心 Renderer 自测”提升为本技能包范围内所有业务任务的强制最终输出约束。

applicability.rule: 凡任务明确使用、继承或受整体闭环极限短时间引擎治理，并进入实阶段，均在本 Scope Gate 范围内。
applicability.locator_trigger: 任何用户可见输出出现【页面名｜任务名｜01-06｜实】即触发完整 Reality Dispatch 校验。

negative_real_counterexample.source: DSE v1.0.3 real-use output supplied by user
negative_real_counterexample.reason: Header/status envelope only; missing numeric standard time contract, DISPATCH_UTC, execution body, complete return contract and production references.

scope_delta.finding: v5.2.1 validated the core renderer path but did not certify skill-wide downstream business enforcement.

minimal_delta_policy: Only add skill-wide Scope Gate and authoritative rules; preserve existing renderer/time/materialization/product logic.
release_requirement: A real-use test from an actual downstream business page must show that a complete command is emitted and the old header-only form is rejected.
